اعتديت (form VIII)
# اِعْتَدَيْتُ (iʕtadaytu) /iʕ.ta.daj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# اِعْتَدَيْتَ (iʕtadayta) /iʕ.ta.daj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# اِعْتَدَيْتِ (iʕtadayti) /iʕ.ta.daj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# اُعْتُدِيتُ (uʕtudītu) /uʕ.tu.diː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
